Engine.description: Agentic coding engine that produced an artifact.
Engine.title: Engine

description:
One row of the release dataset's ``gradings`` table: one judge's grading.

Long form: a prediction graded by three evaluators has three rows, joined to
its ``predictions`` row on ``(case_id, event_id, predictor_id,
prediction_run_id)``. Every grading of an exported prediction is a row,
re-grades and out-of-scope gradings included; ``counted`` and
``excluded_reason`` say which ones the scored figures read.

base_rate_salience_version.description: The salience version the base rate's band population is keyed on; null where the baseline is not banded
base_rate_salience_version.title: Base Rate Salience Version

brier_score.description: The Brier score of `probability` against the outcome; null where not computed
brier_score.title: Brier Score

brier_skill_score.description: The Brier skill score against `segment_base_rate`; null without a baseline
brier_skill_score.title: Brier Skill Score

correct.description: Whether the prediction's binary call matched the outcome: 1 yes, 0 no; null where not graded on it
correct.title: Correct

counted.description: Whether the scored figures count this grading
counted.title: Counted

evaluator_engine.description: The engine the evaluator ran on

evaluator_id.description: The evaluator (judge) that wrote the grading
evaluator_id.title: Evaluator Id

evaluator_model.description: The model the grading records as having run; null where it recorded none. Not back-filled from the engine's default, which can move after a run
evaluator_model.title: Evaluator Model

excluded_reason.description: Why an uncounted grading is not counted: `forward_claim` (the prediction's forward claim is contradicted by its own record), `leakage` (`leakage_suspected` is true), `forward_claim_and_leakage` (both), `superseded` (a newer grading by the same judge of the same predictor on this event replaced it, possibly one of a different prediction run) or `out_of_scope` (the grading's harness stamp is absent or predates the freeze instant); null when counted
excluded_reason.title: Excluded Reason

leakage_suspected.description: The judge's verdict on whether the prediction may have read its own outcome; null where not assessed
leakage_suspected.title: Leakage Suspected

prediction_run_id.description: The graded prediction's run id: `run_id` in the predictions table
prediction_run_id.title: Prediction Run Id

process_digest.description: The evaluator's harness process digest; null on an unstamped grading
process_digest.title: Process Digest

run_id.description: The grading's own run id (a UTC timestamp)
run_id.title: Run Id

segment_base_rate.description: The registered base rate the skill score is measured against; null without one
segment_base_rate.title: Segment Base Rate

stamped_at.description: When the harness stamped the grading (UTC); null on an unstamped grading
stamped_at.title: Stamped At

title: ExportGradingRow
